Here are some basic local testing metrics comparing supernode and full node bandwidth on a small network for anyone interested: https://hackmd.io/MiPD4ZJhQ8qFH1qnZcwKxQ#Network Thanks Jimmy! - > A PeerDAS full node is much lighter in terms of bandwidth usage as shown below Do you know roughly what the reduction is here? ie 2x or 4x - Is there a way to simulate poor connection on these devnets/local testnets? - From this (although not conclusive), it seems that the network bandwidth between a super node and a full node is about 10x for a small network
